label: Capacity Planning Calculator
description: Forecasts resource capacity requirements based on projected workload, seasonal patterns, and efficiency targets. Models staffing scenarios and identifies gaps or over-capacity periods.

claudeKnowledge.description: Workforce planning frameworks, capacity modelling methodologies, resource management best practices

guidedInputs.label: Current capacity and workload
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe your current team/resource setup: how many FTE, what they do, current workload levels, utilisation rates, and any known constraints or bottlenecks.

guidedInputs.label: Future demand forecast
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe expected workload changes: volume growth/decline, new products or services, projects, regulatory programmes, seasonal peaks, and any strategic changes that will affect demand.

guidedInputs.label: Constraints and assumptions
guidedInputs.placeholder: Budget limits, hiring timelines, training lead times, office space constraints, technology procurement timelines, or other relevant constraints.
